title: Top 10 AetherSX2/PS2 Games Playable On Low Spec Phone - Gameplay Test On Snapdragon 636
summary: Mad CatZ assembles a ten-game AetherSX2 shortlist on an Asus Zenfone Max Pro M1 with Snapdragon 636 and only 3 GB of RAM, documenting a genuinely low-spec Android baseline rather than a flagship showcase.

blocks.text: The host specification is the central value of this short gameplay collection: Snapdragon 636, 3 GB RAM, 32 GB storage and Android 9 are all identified, along with AetherSX2 build 3060. That hardware sits far below the flagship devices commonly used in PS2 demonstrations. Selecting ten games creates a practical discovery list for owners of similar older phones and also illustrates that software workload varies widely; a successful lighter title says more about that title than about universal console coverage.

Its public notes omit the ten game names, regions, resolution multipliers, speed settings, cooling state and measured frame rates, so the list must be evaluated from what is actually visible in each segment. “Playable” is subjective and may tolerate audio stretch, slowdown or skipped effects. The discontinued emulator build and Android 9 environment are also dated. Use this as a lead for low-end testing, not a preset: reproduce one title from a cold start, disclose compromises and protect battery health on aging hardware.
